title: Next Steps for Spring Admits (USC Undergraduate Admission)
text:
Note: this page covers Spring 2028 admits (entering USC in January 2028), with fall 2027 planning and deadlines.

SHARED STEPS (FIRST-YEAR AND TRANSFER)
- Commit to enroll in two steps: (1) Submit the Intent to Enroll form in the USC Applicant Portal (non-financial). (2) Pay the $300 commitment deposit, or select a deposit waiver if financial hardship prevents payment. The deposit is nonrefundable and applies to spring 2028 tuition and fees. Space is not guaranteed if the deposit is submitted after the deadline.
- Declining: decline the offer on the Intent to Enroll form in the applicant portal.
- Financial aid: complete the financial aid application as soon as possible. Details are on the Manage Your Finances and Financial Aid pages. Status is viewable in the FAST and Student Forms portals.
- Housing: applications open July 1, 2027, through USC Housing. Spring admits are not guaranteed USC housing, so the page recommends exploring other options. Questions: housing@usc.edu.
- USC NetID: activate it a few days after submitting your enrollment commitment. Orientation information is sent only to your USC email.
- Orientation: sign-up opens April 2027 for Welcome Trojans Spring 2028, a hybrid program.
- Health requirements: vaccination, documentation, and health insurance requirements apply. Requirements are listed at USC Student Health, and records are accessible via the My Student Health Record Portal.
- Academic records: admission is conditional on maintaining academic performance. Declining senior-year grades may lead to contact or, in serious cases, rescinded offers.
- Spring admits may consider community college, study abroad, gap programs, or work and internships. A Course Planning Worksheet is listed as a resource.

FIRST-YEAR STUDENTS
- Intent to Enroll deadline: May 1, submitted online in the USC Applicant Portal. Students who want fall enrollment must submit the Intent to Enroll by May 1. Students admitted to spring receive a mid-May update.
- Commitment deposit deadline: August 1.
- Final transcript: due July 1. Submit the final, official high school transcript showing your graduation date. A photocopy of your diploma is not sufficient.
- International school IB or A-level results: send to USC Transfer Credit Services within one week of release.
- Pre-graduation credit: up to 32 combined elective units from AP, IB, and/or A-level exams and select college courses.
- Study options: USC in D.C. First Semester (FSDC) is available to first-year spring admits only. Five partner schools in Europe offer study abroad.
- Course planning: webinars run late May through early July. Sign up in the applicant portal.

TRANSFER STUDENTS
- Intent to Enroll deadline: submit by August 1 or within two weeks of receiving your offer of admission, whichever is later.
- Commitment deposit deadline: August 1.
- Academic records: submit as soon as possible. Request official transcripts showing final grades once your current term ends.
- Fall placement: transfer students receive an update only if space becomes available.
- Transfer Credit Reports: expected online at Experience USC by early December.
- International transfer coursework: contact the International Education Research Foundation (IERF).
- FSDC: not eligible.

INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS
- Students need valid non-immigrant status. The F-1 is the most common visa.
- Initial I-20 requests are submitted through Trojan International after committing and paying the deposit. Requests are not accepted before July 2027.
- Immigration Status Verification (ISV): complete with the Office of International Services upon arrival. ISV is separate from orientation.
- English proficiency: if you were asked to show proficiency and did not submit an approved exam, you must take the International Student Exam (ISE) through the American Language Institute later in summer. Submitting an approved exam, including the SAT or ACT, waives this.

CONTACTS
- Questions: USC admission counselor at (213) 740-1111, or askUSC
- Electronic transcripts: uetrans@usc.edu
- Physical transcripts: USC Office of Admission, Undergraduate, University Park Campus, Los Angeles, CA 90089-0911
